# Optional upstream integration notice

MFLab can optionally load a local checkout of:

- CodeRafay / Rafay Adeel, **Forensic-Image-Analysis-Toolkit (Veritas)**
- https://github.com/CodeRafay/Forensic-Image-Analysis-Toolkit
- License: BSD 3-Clause

MFLab does not vendor the upstream source by default. If the user clones it via `scripts/fetch_external_tools.py`, the upstream repository remains under `.external/` with its own `LICENSE` file and copyright notice.
